card.name: DR in capitalized DRUG(S)
card.fires_on: The letters DR that start the word DRUG or DRUGS when it is split up in all-caps label text, mostly after words like CONCOMITANT, OTHER, ANTIDEPRESSANT or SUSPECT.

modes.label: DRUGS in warning headings
modes.description: DR begins DRUGS in all-caps boxed warning or heading text.
modes.example: WARNING: SUICIDAL THOUGHTS AND BEHAVIORS SUICIDALITY AND ANTIDEPRESSANT<< DR>>UGS Antidepressants increased the risk

modes.label: DRUG in all-caps warning sentences
modes.description: DR begins DRUG or DRUGS after a modifier in an all-caps precaution sentence.
modes.example: SINCE CHOLESTYRAMINE MAY BIND OTHER DRUGS GIVEN CONCURRENTLY, IT IS RECOMMENDED THAT PATIENTS TAKE OTHER<< DR>>UGS AT LEAST ONE HOUR BEFORE

card.writes: It promotes the letters dr and Dr, so it pushes the model to write the start of DRUG.
card.plain: It fires on the first letters of the word DRUG when a label writes it in capitals.
